estimatedFinalCostHint: Forecast Final Cost net = Actual net + remaining commitments + expected remaining cost. Not a separate opaque engine.
estimatedProfitBasedOnEnteredData: Estimated profit on net contract, excluding VAT

kpis.currentContractHint: Original contract ± approved changes, excluding VAT. Pending changes stay out.
kpis.pendingNotInContract: Not included in Current Contract until approved.
kpis.actualCostHint: Finalized direct cost, labor, vendors, shared, and allocated overhead on this project, plus surviving post-close corrections once. Drafts excluded. VAT excluded. This is the net basis for profit - not an invoice total.
kpis.allocatedOverheadHint: Share of business overhead allocated to this project. Unallocated overhead does not appear here.
kpis.allocatedOverheadSourceHint: From finalized allocation lines that target this project.
kpis.committedHint: Open purchase-order commitment - not Actual Cost. Stays separate until consumed.
kpis.forecastHint: Actual Cost + remaining commitments + expected remaining cost (ETC), without double-counting.
kpis.forecastEqualsActualHint: Forecast equals Actual Cost while there are no open commitments and no expected remaining cost.
kpis.expectedRemainingHint: Uncovenanted ETC entered on the project - not PO commitments.
kpis.committedInForecastHint: Open PO remaining commitment included once in Forecast Final Cost.
kpis.billedHint: Customer invoice total on this project, including VAT if entered. Billing/cash amount - not revenue for profit.
kpis.paidHint: Cash collected against invoices on this project, at invoice total.
kpis.outstandingHint: Invoice total minus Paid minus held retainage, including VAT if entered. Forecast collection - not profit.
kpis.actualMarginHint: Profit on net contract excluding VAT - Actual Cost net. Not a cash figure and not an invoice total.
kpis.forecastMarginHint: Profit on net contract excluding VAT - Forecast Cost net.
kpis.forecastMarginEqualsActualHint: Same as Actual Margin while Forecast Cost equals Actual Cost.
kpis.priceNotSetHint: Open-price job: costs and cost forecast still accumulate. Profit and margin are not claimed until a revenue basis is set.

basis.netExVat: Net basis, excluding VAT - not an invoice total.
basis.billingCash: Billing/cash amount, including VAT if entered - not revenue for profit.
basis.profitNet: Profit on net contract, excluding VAT.
basis.outstandingCash: Cash outstanding to collect - open invoice totals, not profit.
basis.cashNotProfit: Cash/billing amount - not profit and not Actual Cost net.

explain.infoLineHint: Shown for context - not added again into the total.

formulas.actual: Actual Cost net = original recognized project costs ± post-close month-close corrections (once), excluding VAT. Families, vendor bills, and labor are the original recognized amount. Drafts and open POs stay out.
formulas.forecast: Forecast Final Cost net = Actual net + remaining PO commitments + expected remaining cost (ETC). Open AP payable is cash-only disclosure.
formulas.current_contract: Current Contract net = original managed value ± approved additions/reductions, excluding VAT. Pending changes stay out.
formulas.actual_margin: Actual profit net = Current Contract net - Actual Cost net. Not an invoice total.
formulas.forecast_margin: Forecast profit net = Current Contract net - Forecast Final Cost net. Not an invoice total.
formulas.unallocated_cost: Unallocated business costs await allocation - counted in organization expense totals, never forced into project Actual or profit.
formulas.outstanding_ar: Outstanding to collect = Invoice total - Paid - held retainage. Forecast collection, not profit.
formulas.outstanding_ap: Outstanding AP = unmatched open vendor bills payable. Cash obligation disclosure - not Actual Cost.

cashFlow.forecastHint: This project’s Outstanding billing by due date. Not Paid.
cashFlow.outgoingDisclosure: Outgoing cash is not forecast here: no open vendor bills with due dates are in scope. Expenses alone do not invent vendor invoices.
cashFlow.outgoingAvailableHint: Forecast from open vendor bills by due date - not Expense actual cost.
cashFlow.undatedNote: Outstanding without a due date stays under “No due date” and is not timed into a Forecast bucket.

perContract.title: By contract
perContract.hint: Current contract value is shown per live contract (draft/active) and summed for the project. Closed and cancelled contracts stay listed for history and are not included in the project current total. Cost and profit stay at project level - they are not split across contracts.
perContract.costProfitHint: Cost and profit remain project-level. This list does not allocate cost or invent per-contract profit.
perContract.skippedFx: Another currency - not included in the project total
